SRM Number: 1767
SRM Name: Low Alloy Steel
Under the U.S. Department of Labor, Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) 29 CFR 1910.1200,
this Standard Reference Material (SRM) is NOT classified as a physical hazard or a health hazard, a simple
asphyxiant, combustible dust, pyrophoric gas, or hazard not otherwise classified. There are no hazard pictograms,
hazard statements or signal word associated with it. Safety Data Sheet information is not required. This document
may be used in conjunction with your hazard communication program. Articles are exempted per 1910.1200(c).

Description: This SRM is a low alloy steel and is intended for use in optical emission and X -ray spectrometric
methods of analysis. A unit of SRM 1767 consists of a disk approximately 34 mm in diameter and 19 mm thick.
Disposal: SRM 1767 should be disposed of in accordance with local, state, and federal regulations.

Transport Information: This material is not regulated by the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) and/or
International Air Transportation Association (IATA).

Disclaimer: The NIST information in this document is specific to the NIST product and is believed to be correct,
based upon our current knowledge. This document may not necessarily be all inclusive and should be used only as a
guide. NIST does not guarantee the accuracy or completeness of this information. The only official source for
specific values and uncertainties is the certificate or report.
Users of this SRM should ensure that this document and the corresponding Certificate of Analysis in their
possession are current. This can be accomplished by contacting the SRM Program: telephone (301) 975-2200;
e-mail srmmsds@nist.gov; or via the Internet at https://www.nist.gov/srm .
